## What's New in Quote 2.1.1

* 82 quotes in the library read properly again: lines of poems and dialogue no longer run into each other ("born and once" instead of "bornAnd once"), and missing full stops are back. Saved quotes keep their place in your favorites
* One quote attributed to Adolf Hitler is no longer part of the library
* The daily reminder now asks Android for the exact time when it would otherwise arrive up to an hour late, and comes back by itself if Android dropped it
* The reminder no longer fires twice when the clock or time zone is set back after it went off
* Tapping the widget or the reminder no longer closes a quote you are editing in Saved
* Removing your own published quote from favorites no longer leaves an identical copy behind
* "Save" on the reminder notification now shows on the Daily screen right away
* Library filters: combining "Local" or "Community" with a category no longer mixes in quotes from the other source
* "No matches" and empty lists are no longer hidden behind the keyboard or the bottom bar
* In landscape, buttons no longer slip under a side navigation bar or a camera cutout
* A tag made only of invisible characters no longer makes "Add" close the form without saving
* Restoring a backup while leaving Settings no longer crashes the app
* Very long text shared from other apps no longer freezes Quote
* A misconfigured server can no longer mark your pending submissions as deleted
* A quote that was rejected can be sent again after you changed its category, tags or language
* Downloaded updates are deleted once they are installed
* Larger touch targets for tags
